title: Fig. 8. Example prompts and questions for starting broad and narrowing down

parts.words: Intent & Introductions “Tell me about your background… …as a health worker.”
“Tell me about the last time you… …registered a new client.” …provided antenatal care.” …provided a routine immunization to a child.”
“Can you tell me more… …about how you check for malaria?”
“Can you show me how you… …would fill out a paper register now?”
5 Why’s “Why do you… …wait until the end of the day to fill out your records?” Based on answer, continue to ask why until a root cause is revealed.
Express gratitude for health worker’s time
